# PLAN — iteration 1

## Current state assessment

The verified incumbent uses 3 LUTs and 4 FFs and passes simulation, setup (WNS 0.57 ns), and hold (WHS 0.057 ns). Timing is already feasible, so promotion requires a strict LUT reduction, with FFs as the tie-breaker; the current 3-bit counter and registered output leave little obvious area to remove.

## Hypothesis

Inlining the frozen child and expressing the 3-bit count update as explicit toggle equations may let Vivado share the terminal-count condition and reduce LUT use while retaining the same four FFs.

## Instruction for generator

Replace the child instance with equivalent logic in `debouncer_top`, keeping `// @latency 0` and a 3-bit consecutive-sample state. Express the modulo-8 increment with per-bit toggle equations so the terminal test for count 7 can share the carry condition; synchronously clear the count when `noisy == clean`, and on the eighth differing sample update `clean` and clear the count. Preserve synchronous active-high reset priority, the exact eight-sample threshold, registered `clean`, and all ports; the proposal succeeds only if routed LUT count is strictly lower and every verification and timing gate passes.
